## What he does

Yaqwb builds the frontend for real, shipping products — not just demos. He works across the modern React ecosystem (React, Next.js, React Router) and pairs implementation with UI/UX judgment: layout, motion, accessibility, and performance. He's comfortable owning a frontend end-to-end, from architecture and state management to responsive, polished interfaces, and has shipped work across e-commerce, travel, and business-communication products.

## Tech stack

React, Next.js, React Router, JavaScript, Redux Toolkit, Context API, Tailwind CSS, Sass, Framer Motion, Node.js, Laravel (integration), Vue.js (integration), Bootstrap, responsive/mobile-first UI, Git/GitHub.

## Shipped projects (proof of work)

1. **iZone** — https://www.izoneiraq.com/
   Apple products e-commerce platform for the Iraqi market. Stack: React Router, Laravel, Tailwind CSS. Built for fast browsing, current pricing, and a fully responsive experience across devices.

2. **Botolon** — https://www.botolon.com/
   Business chatbot / customer-communication platform. Stack: Next.js, Node.js, Sass. Contributed the responsive, user-facing interface for automated business-customer messaging.

3. **ErbilianWay** — https://erbiliantravel.com/
   Website for a travel company established 2016. Stack: Laravel, Bootstrap, Vue.js. Built the frontend showcasing travel packages and services.

4. **LinkPlus** — https://link-plus.vercel.app/ (code: https://github.com/Yaqub-naqeb/LinkPlus)
   Professional networking platform for job seekers and employers. Stack: Next.js, React, Redux Toolkit.

5. **AVIBOOKS** — https://avibooks.vercel.app/ (code: https://github.com/Yaqub-naqeb/AviBooks)
   Book e-commerce platform with curated browsing and free-book selection. Stack: React, Context API, Tailwind CSS.
